devicesHelp: Use the Device Manager below to add, edit, enable, pair or remove devices. Changes are saved to native.devices and restart the adapter automatically.
Name: Name
ipHelp: Shown in the device's network settings
connRemoteAdb: Android TV / Google TV – with title and play/pause (ADB required)
enableImeTooltip: Switch off only if the TV keeps showing 'Use keyboard on mobile device'.
stepPair: Pairing (only needed once): switch the device on. After adding it, choose “Pair device” from its Device Manager actions and enter the 6-character code shown on the TV.
stepAdbRemote: Playback info: on the SHIELD open Settings › Device Preferences › Developer options and switch on “Network debugging”. If the developer options are missing: Settings › Device Preferences › About, click “Build” 7 times. Confirm “Allow debugging?” on the TV and tick “Always allow”.
stepAdbFire: ADB access: on the Fire TV open Settings › My Fire TV › Developer options and switch on “ADB debugging”. If the developer options are missing: Settings › My Fire TV › About, click the device name 7 times. Confirm “Allow USB debugging?” on the TV and tick “Always allow from this computer”.
adbSecurity: Note: with debugging switched on, other devices in your home network can access the TV as well. Only use it in your own, trusted network.
appsHelp: Apps you want to start with one click. Each entry becomes a button for every device. Enter the app's web link (e.g. https://www.netflix.com/title). Apps without a link can be entered with their app ID (e.g. Emby: com.mb.android) – this works on Fire TV and with “with title and play/pause”.
adbPollHelp: Only while the device is switched on.
clientNameHelp: Shown on the TV during pairing
reconnectMaxHelp: If a device is unreachable, the time between attempts grows from 2 s up to this value.
support_text: The adapter is free. If it is useful to you, you can support its development voluntarily.
wolMacHelp: Optional, only needed to switch the device on from deep standby. Shown in the network settings of the device or in your router (with a cable: the MAC of the LAN port)
wolBroadcastHelp: Only needed if the device is in another network (e.g. 192.168.20.255)
connectionHelp: Standard: on/off, apps and remote buttons – enter a code shown on the TV once. With title and play/pause and for Fire TV: switch on a developer option on the device (see guide).
invalidPin: The code must have 6 characters (0-9, A-F).
